_comment: Vanzik MCP Gateway config for Cursor. See cursor-config.md for the file path (global vs project) and verification steps. Source: https://cursor.com/docs/context/mcp (verified 2026-05-05). Cursor's ${env:VAR} interpolation is unreliable across versions — prefer the env block, which the gateway reads via VANZIK_API_KEY when the --api-key flag is absent. --tenant-id selects the tenant whose policy applies; keep 'local' unless you registered another tenant on the server with `vanzik tenant put`.
